statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-68383 affects the Filebeat Syslog parser and Libbeat Dissect processor in Beats 8.0.0 through 8.19.8, 9.0.0 through 9.1.8, and 9.2.0 through 9.2.2. Elastic fixed the vulnerability in 8.19.9, 9.1.9, and 9.2.3. Each Filebeat version listed in this statement's products is at or above the matching upstream fix release and does not contain the vulnerable code; Scout still reports the CVE because its advisory applies an unfixed broad range to the elastic/beats Go module PURLs.
